name: Mac Slider
description: Liquid glass slider with squircle normal map refraction, specular rim sheen, and tactile spring physics.
summary: A native-feeling macOS slider component built with physics-based liquid glass optics and damped harmonic oscillator springs. Features real-time squircle normal-map displacement, specular edge reflections, and dynamic transparency that shifts from solid white at rest to optical glass when dragged, coupled with responsive track scrubbing, multiple sizes, materials, and keyboard navigation.
highlights: Ultra-smooth pointer-capture tracking with zero-latency MotionValue synchronization
Real-time squircle normal-map refraction distortion using SVG feDisplacementMap
Dynamic specular lighting highlights along the 16px convex squircle lens bezel
Damped harmonic spring dynamics (stiffness: 400, damping: 30) for tactile drag expansion
Fluid state morphing from solid white pill at rest to translucent liquid glass under drag
Accurate sub-pixel track fill tracking the exact optical center of the thumb
Three size variants (sm, md, lg) and three glass materials (liquid, frosted, clear)
Seven color themes including macOS System Blue, Emerald, Violet, Amber, Rose, Cyan, and Graphite
Full keyboard accessibility with Arrow keys, PageUp/Down, Home, End, and ARIA slider semantics
Live interactive parameter sliders driven by MotionValues with zero React re-render overhead
anatomy: <motion.div> (Track shell with role="slider", ARIA value attributes, and focus ring)
<motion.div> (Active progress fill bar tracking thumb center)
<Filter> (Scoped SVG filter with normal map, feGaussianBlur, feDisplacementMap, feSpecularLighting, feColorMatrix)
<motion.div> (Draggable thumb pill with spring-driven scale, liquid background, and specular sheen)

physics.engine: Harmonic Damped Spring Oscillator & SVG Refraction Shader
physics.description: Analytical spring integration driving scale expansion, backdrop opacity, and track seek animations, coupled with GPU-accelerated displacement mapping.

accessibility.aria: Standard role="slider" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and focus-visible ring.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Instant state transitions and graceful settling when motion is reduced.

keyboard.description: Decrease or increase value by 10 steps.
Jump to minimum or maximum value.

recommended: Audio volume controls, brightness adjustments, and media scrubber interfaces
Control Center style settings panels where authentic macOS tactile feel is desired
Creative tool sliders and shader parameter controllers
bestPractices: Position over visually rich backgrounds to showcase the optical refraction effect
Ensure sufficient contrast between the track background and active progress fill
Provide explicit min, max, and onChange callbacks for controlled state integration

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled slider value between min and max.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled slider usage.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value of the slider range.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value of the slider range.

props.name: step
props.description: Stepping increment for the slider value.

props.name: color
props.description: Theme accent color for the active progress bar and ambient glow.

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset controlling track width, height, and thumb scale.

props.name: material
props.description: Glass optical material for the thumb lens.

props.name: forceActive
props.description: Whether the thumb lens is forcefully expanded.

props.name: specularOpacity
props.description: Intensity of the specular light reflection (0 - 1).

props.name: blurLevel
props.description: Gaussian blur standard deviation in pixels (0 - 40).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the slider value changes.

props.description: Additional CSS class names for outer container.
